en.title: Global Macro — Long yields are becoming a refinancing constraint, not just a valuation shock
en.deck: The Treasury selloff is now transmitting into mortgages, global sovereign yields and emerging-market currencies, turning the long-rate shock from an asset-pricing event into a broader financing constraint.
en.regime: High long sovereign yields are propagating from asset valuation into household, corporate and cross-border financing conditions.
en.key_risk: A persistent combination of long yields above 5%, mortgage rates above 7% and renewed energy inflation turns market repricing into a broader refinancing squeeze.

pt-BR.title: Global Macro — Juros longos começam a virar restrição de refinanciamento, não apenas choque de valuation
pt-BR.deck: A venda de Treasuries já se transmite para hipotecas, juros soberanos globais e moedas emergentes, transformando o choque de juros longos de um evento de precificação em restrição mais ampla de financiamento.
pt-BR.regime: Juros soberanos longos elevados se propagam da precificação de ativos para as condições de financiamento de famílias, empresas e fluxos internacionais.
pt-BR.key_risk: Combinação persistente de juros longos acima de 5%, hipotecas acima de 7% e nova inflação de energia transforma a reprecificação de mercado em aperto mais amplo de refinanciamento.

novelty_gate.dominant_delta: The 24 September long-rate selloff moved from a market repricing into observable refinancing transmission: the official 10-year Treasury closed at 5.18%, the 30-year at 5.47%, Freddie Mac's 30-year mortgage reached 7.03%, Japan's 10-year yield extended to 3.115%, and emerging-market FX pressure became more visible.
novelty_gate.repetition_control: The report does not repeat the 24 September thesis that stronger activity caused a sovereign-duration shock. It advances the mechanism by testing where that shock is now entering household borrowing, sovereign funding, global rates and emerging-market currencies; oil remains a conditional inflation channel rather than the dominant thesis.
